title: Kozuchi Agent: A Language-Agnostic Open-Weight Agent for Software Repair
abstract: arXiv:2608.15579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial software-engineering teams increasingly need LLM agents that turn bug reports into correct patches, yet benchmark-scale operation adds long horizons, tool-use discipline, context persistence, heterogeneous clusters, and evaluation reuse. We present Kozuchi Agent, a language-agnostic open-weight repair agent and CI-operated evaluation pipeline. Explicit phases, persistent state, deterministic tools, a model-independent action interface, and cross-agent test-time selection make runs auditable and repeatable. With locally hosted Qwen3.5-27B, no fine-tuning, and TTS@8, Kozuchi resolves 374/500 SWE-bench Verified instances on the official evaluator. Unchanged on Multi-SWE-bench Java, the same 27-billion-parameter agent resolves 41/128 instances (32.03%), ranking first among strict open-weight submissions and fourth of 42 overall; on Python it ranks 12th of 135 and first among open-weight systems. translated_title: Kozuchi Agent：一种语言无关的开源权重软件修复智能体
translated_abstract: 工业软件工程团队越来越需要能够将缺陷报告转化为正确补丁的LLM智能体，但基准规模的操作增加了长时程、工具使用纪律、上下文持久性、异构集群和评估复用等挑战。我们提出了Kozuchi Agent，一种语言无关的开源权重修复智能体和CI驱动的评估流水线。明确的阶段、持久状态、确定性工具、模型无关的动作接口以及跨智能体的测试时选择，使运行过程可审计且可重复。使用本地托管的Qwen3.5-27B模型，无需微调，在TTS@8设置下，Kozuchi在官方评估器上解决了SWE-bench Verified中的374/500个实例。在Multi-SWE-bench Java上保持不变，同一个27亿参数智能体解决了41/128个实例（32.03%），在严格开源权重提交中排名第一，在42个总体提交中排名第四；在Python上排名第135中的第12位，并在开源权重系统中排名第一。各阶段行为保持在...
tldr: Kozuchi Agent通过明确阶段、持久状态和模型无关接口，实现了一种无需微调的语言无关开源权重软件修复智能体，在SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE-bench上取得了领先性能。
en_tdlr: Kozuchi Agent achieves a language-agnostic open-weight software repair agent with explicit phases, persistent state, and model-independent interfaces, attaining leading performance on SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench without fine-tuning.
